newsitem.title: USA: BankBoston names ex-Citicorp exec as Brazil chief.
newsitem.headline: BankBoston names ex-Citicorp exec as Brazil chief.

text.p: BankBoston named former Citicorp executive Carlos Craide to manage its Brazilian banking operations Wednesday.
Craide, 49, will succeed Henrique de Campos Meirelles who was recently named president and chief operating officer of Bank Boston.
Craide will be in charge of an Sao Paulo-based operation that has $4.8 billion in assets, 28 branches and 28,000 account customers, BankBoston said in a statement.

He joined BankBoston after 22 years with Citibank where he was most recently the head of corporate banking and bank products in Brazil. A graduate of the Federal University in Rio Grande Do Sul State, Craide has also worked with a Brazilian bank associated with Bankers Trust Co.
